caption: The drawing depicts a metallic serving utensil composed of two large, oval-shaped spoon bowls connected by an ornate, pierced handle, with articulation allowing the lower spoon to move. The lower oval bowl features a decorative cut-out pattern, while the upper bowls have a smooth surface with shading indicative of a reflective silver or steel material. The object is positioned diagonally, occupying the central portion of a mostly blank, off-white background that displays pale brownish-yellow vertical and horizontal stains and smudges, particularly evident near the vertical axis and near the bottom edge. There are no additional objects or decorations within the composition.
title: Silver Folding Spoon
